issues.quote: revenue rising 5.2% to $391.0 billion from $383.3 billion
issues.problem: Growth from $383.3B to $391.0B is about 2.0%, not 5.2%.

data.summary: All dollar figures, margins, the net income change and EPS match Apple's FY2024 results. The only error is the revenue growth rate: it was about 2.0%, not 5.2%. The analysis also leaves out that the drop in net income came from a one-time charge of about $10.2B tied to the EU state aid decision on Ireland.
